component.name: nuxeo.labs.webdavdirectedit.transientstore
component.documentation:
Scratch space for the temporary files Microsoft Office creates while it saves.
Office does not save with a single PUT. It writes the new content to a .tmp file, moves the original aside, moves the temporary file onto the original name and deletes the leftover. It also keeps a ~$ owner file for the whole editing session. None of those are documents, and none of them belong in the repository: the platform's own WebDAV module creates them as real documents and deletes them afterwards, which is why they flash by in the Web UI. Here they live in this transient store instead and expire on their own.
Entries are small and short-lived: the save dance takes seconds, and only the owner file lasts the session.
@since 2025.1
